title: Fillet corners on cubes now use sphere octants
summary: build_vertex_faces emitted a flat planar triangle at each corner where 3 cylinder fillets meet — the chord vs adjacent cylinder arc mismatch produced a visible lens-shaped z-fight at every cube corner. Cube-style corners (3 mutually orthogonal faces) now get a true SphereSurface tangent to all 3 faces; the boundary great circles match the cylinders' v-arc caps.
